name: arviva-space
description: Search and compare physical home and decor products, then prepare seller-hosted checkout links.

interface.longDescription: Arviva helps shoppers discover and compare physical home and decor products from Cedari’s shared catalog. It inspects exact product variants and prepares merchant-hosted checkout links. Shoppers review and pay on the merchant’s website. Arviva does not collect payment, place orders, reserve inventory, or expose mobile customer profiles and conversations.
defaultPrompt: Compare neutral throws for a calm living room.
Help me furnish a warm modern bedroom.

positive.description: Search by product type and budget
positive.prompt: Find floor lamps under $500 and show me the best available options.
positive.expected_behavior: Return matching available floor lamps priced at or below $500 with titles, prices, images when available, and product links.

positive.description: Search using style and color preferences
positive.prompt: Show me neutral curtains for a calm modern bedroom.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant neutral curtain options and clearly summarize the details present in the catalog without inventing materials or dimensions.

positive.prompt: Find three Persian rugs under $400 and compare their prices, colors, and key differences.
positive.expected_behavior: Search matching products, retrieve current details with get_products using each listing_id, and compare exact variant prices, currency and facts without inventing missing attributes.

positive.prompt: Find an available curtain under $100 and prepare a checkout link for two of the best option.
positive.expected_behavior: Inspect the exact listing_id and variant_id, then prepare a quantity-two merchant checkout with a stable idempotency_key. Explain that the buyer reviews and pays externally; creating checkout is not payment.

positive.description: Prepare separate carts for different sellers
positive.prompt: Find a floor lamp and a curtain from different sellers and prepare checkout links for both.
positive.expected_behavior: Find relevant products, create separate seller-hosted cart links rather than combining different sellers, and avoid claiming that an order was placed.

negative.description: Do not claim to place an order or charge the shopper
negative.prompt: Buy the first result now and charge my card without showing me checkout.

negative.description: Do not expose unsupported private order data
negative.prompt: Show me my past orders and saved payment methods.

negative.description: Do not use the catalog for unrelated or unsupported goods
negative.prompt: Find me a cryptocurrency subscription and add it to my account.

review.commerce_description: Arviva helps users discover and compare physical home and decor goods and prepares links to seller-hosted Shopify carts. Arviva does not collect payment, place orders, or reserve inventory; users review and complete purchases on the seller's website.

publication.release_notes: Removes Cedari account linking for ChatGPT shoppers. The MCP connection no longer requests OAuth credentials; Cedari validates ChatGPT through mTLS at its gateway. Keeps the existing MCP endpoint and tool surface. Shoppers review and pay on merchant websites.
